title: UI scaling and font size broken in landscape mode on Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 (Unfolded)
body: ## Description When using the app on the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 on the main (unfolded) display in landscape orientation (4:3 aspect ratio), the app layout scaling and font sizes break. Elements appear stretched/misaligned, and text renders either oversized or truncated. ## Environment Device: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 (Unfolded / Inner Display) Orientation: Landscape mode (unfolded) App Version: 3.4.2.5 (Stable) OS: Android 17 / One UI, June security patch (newest as of 03.08.2026) ## Steps to Reproduce Open the app on a Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8. Unfold the device to use the main inner screen. Rotate the device into Landscape mode. Observe the UI layout and text rendering across main screens. ## Expected Behavior The UI elements and typography should scale dynamically to fit the Fold 8’s new aspect ratio without breaking font proportions or overlapping elements. ## Actual Behavior Font sizes scale improperly (overly large/small/clipped), and layout spacing breaks across multiple screens in landscape orientation. ## Screenshots ### Folded Portrait: ### Folded Landscape: ### Unfolded Portrait: ### Unfolded Landscape:
